digest.component_or_area: DC outbound mutation reconciliation / text field limits
propositions: DC lacks two-pass convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions that Cloud has, creating risk of repeated re-emission of truncated changes

DC's sanitize_comment binding reuses the description fitter (fit_outbound) and WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767), which is the correct documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit covering both comments and text custom fields per JRASERVER-28519, but this provenance is not cited in source

A convergence test driven through compute_outbound_mutations without explicitly injecting all three of outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, and links silently falls back to the Cloud backend via select_backend(load_config()), causing the test to pass while validating the wrong deployment

A convergence test for comments must use identity/recording checks on the injected sanitizer, not value-based assertions, because DC and Cloud both truncate at 32767 and append identical suffix markers, making value assertions vacuous

The DC comment ceiling of 32767 is established and correct for stock Jira >= 7.0 but is admin-configurable on individual instances, creating data loss risk when rebar hardcodes the default rather than querying the live limit
